stories.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
stories.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

stories.zh_summary: 消息人士透露，Clutch 得到了 Lightspeed 和 SignalFire 的支持，最新估值為 8,500 萬美元。

stories.summary: Airbnb plans to roll out an AI agent in the first half of 2027 that will help users plan and book travel, the company said in its Q3 2026 earnings shareholder letter released today. stories.title: Ads in Chatbots Have Arrived. Here’s What’s Working—and What’s Not
stories.summary: As Anthropic maintains its vow to keep ads out of Claude, the rest of the AI chatbot industry is racing to win over advertisers without antagonizing users.
stories.zh_title: 聊天機器人中的廣告已經到來。以下是有效的方法和無效的方法
stories.zh_summary: 隨著 Anthropic 堅守不讓 Claude 看到廣告的誓言，人工智慧聊天機器人行業的其他公司正在競相爭取廣告商的支持，同時又不會激怒用戶。

stories.title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
stories.summary: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. stories.zh_title: Claude AI 可以直接插入您的銀行帳戶

stories.title: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
stories.summary: OpenAI is launching GPT-6 Cyber, the latest version of its cybersecurity AI model, which it says is better at finding vulnerabilities and less likely to go rogue and hack other platforms in the process. stories.title: Nasdaq sell-off batters Asian chip stocks as SK Hynix, Samsung, Softbank, TSMC tumble
stories.summary: Asian technology stocks tumbled Friday, tracking a sharp sell-off on Wall Street overnight that sent the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite into correction territory.
stories.zh_title: SK 海力士、三星、軟銀、台積電暴跌，納斯達克拋售重創亞洲晶片股
stories.zh_summary: 亞洲科技股週五暴跌，追隨隔夜華爾街的大幅拋售，導致以科技股為主的納斯達克綜合指數進入調整區間。

stories.title: Jim Cramer explains why no AI stock seems safe from the market carnage
stories.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said AI stocks are becoming increasingly difficult to value.
stories.zh_title: 吉姆·克萊默（Jim Cramer）解釋了為什麼沒有人工智慧股票似乎可以免受市場大屠殺
stories.zh_summary: CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 表示，人工智慧股票的估值變得越來越困難。

stories.title: Tech stocks log worst day since 2020 as carnage comes to the AI trade
stories.summary: The S&P 500 lost an estimated $2.9 trillion in market capitalization, the largest one-day loss of market value on record.
stories.zh_title: 人工智慧產業慘遭屠殺，科技股遭遇 2020 年以來最糟糕的一天
stories.zh_summary: 標準普爾 500 指數市值損失估計達 2.9 兆美元，這是有史以​​來最大的單日市值損失。

stories.title: Google: Schools can keep search while skipping Gemini, but AI search is non-negotiable
stories.summary: Google is technically offering schools more choice but not the choices anyone wants.
stories.zh_title: Google：學校可以保留搜索，跳過Gemini，但人工智慧搜索不容談判
stories.zh_summary: 從技術上講，谷歌為學校提供了更多選擇，但並不是任何人想要的選擇。

stories.title: After tech-stock rout, October jobs report could bring relief — or more pain
stories.summary: After a tech-led meltdown in the stock market, the October jobs report on Friday morning could bring investors some encouraging news — or add to their misery.
stories.zh_title: 科技股暴跌後，十月就業報告可能會帶來緩解，但也可能帶來更多痛苦
stories.zh_summary: 在科技股主導的股市崩盤之後，週五上午發布的 10 月就業報告可能會給投資者帶來一些鼓舞人心的消息，或加劇他們的痛苦。

stories.title: Is this ‘the big one’ for the stock market? Wall Street sounds off as tech plunges.
stories.summary: A punishing selloff in the tech space caused carnage in the stock market Thursday, one day after equities saw a big bounce after the Democrats swept Tuesday’s midterm elections.
stories.zh_title: 這是股市的「大事件」嗎？隨著科技股暴跌，華爾街發出了聲音。
stories.zh_summary: 週四，在民主黨在中期選舉中大獲全勝後，股市出現大幅反彈，科技領域的慘重拋售導致週四股市大跌。

stories.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
stories.summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
stories.zh_title: Meta 表示美國用戶現在可以與他們的 Muse AI 頭像進行視訊聊天
stories.zh_summary: Meta 的人工智慧代理現在可以作為可自訂的動畫化身接聽電話，隨後推出一款類似電子寵物蛋的可穿戴設備，旨在讓 Muse 栩栩如生。

stories.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
stories.summary: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 發布了新的網路安全模型。夠了嗎？
stories.zh_summary: 隨著人工智慧實驗室保護數位基礎設施的工作面臨嚴格審查，OpenAI 推出了最新的網路安全模型。

stories.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
stories.summary: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.
stories.zh_title: Dropbox 以 3.5 億美元收購 Tigris Data，以加強其人工智慧基礎設施
stories.zh_summary: 該交易預計將支援 DBX Agent Cloud 的開發，這是一個新的儲存平台，旨在幫助開發人員建立人工智慧模型和代理。

stories.title: Exclusive: Aina’s Smart Ring Wants to Be a Remote Control for Your AI Agent
stories.summary: The startup Aina bets you won’t need to rely on your phone to control virtual assistants. It’s making a smart ring that lets you control the actions of your autonomous agents with one tap.
stories.zh_title: 獨家：Aina 的智慧指環希望成為人工智慧代理的遠端控制
stories.zh_summary: 新創公司 Aina 打賭，你將不需要依靠手機來控制虛擬助理。它正在製作一個智慧環，讓您只需輕輕一按即可控制自主代理的操作。

stories.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
stories.summary: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device […]
stories.zh_title: Perplexity 推出了自己的人工智慧工作代理
stories.zh_summary: Perplexity 正在透過自己的以工作為中心的人工智慧代理來挑戰 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。這家新創公司全新的始終在線的「隊友」可以在工作空間中扮演多個角色，同時從您已經使用的 Perplexity 工具中提取現有項目、技能和記憶。隊友與困惑融為一體

stories.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
stories.summary: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.
stories.zh_title: Axiom Math 希望讓人工智慧遠離數學
stories.zh_summary: 隨著人工智慧在數學中充斥著未經檢查的證明，Axiom Math 正押注於驗證。該新創公司的人工智慧代理商剛剛正式驗證了 Stacks 項目，這是該領域最大的圖書館之一。

stories.title: A YC startup is putting $1M behind 5 unsolved materials science problems for AI
stories.summary: While frontier AI models have solved a remarkable series of outstanding mathematics problems and made progress in the life sciences, they have yet to truly plumb the complex physics in advanced materials.
stories.zh_title: 一家 YC 新創公司將投入 100 萬美元支持 5 個未解決的 AI 材料科學問題
stories.zh_summary: 雖然前沿人工智慧模型已經解決了一系列引人注目的數學問題，並在生命科學領域取得了進展，但它們尚未真正探索先進材料中的複雜物理現象。
